XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='2.4:DFT_P03' targetDocType='2.3.1:DFT_P03' create='new' language='objectscript' > <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='"SAFETRACE"' property='target.{MSH:SendingApplication}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID}' property='target.{PID}' action='set' /> <if condition='target.{PID:PatientAccountNumber.ID} =""' > <true> <assign value='source.{PV1:VisitNumber.ID}' property='target.{PID:PatientAccountNumber.ID}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.{FT1grp(1).FT1}' property='target.{FT1grp(1).FT1}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.{FT1grp(1).FT1:TransactionDate.timeofanevent} '= ""' > <true> <assign value='source.{FT1grp(1).FT1:TransactionDate}' property='target.{FT1grp(1).FT1:TransactionPostingDate}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.{FT1grp(1).FT1:TransactionCode.identifierST} '= ""' > <true> <assign value='"CDM"' property='target.{FT1grp(1).FT1:TransactionCode.nameofcodingsystem}' action='set' > <annotation>Set to CDM when FT1-7.1 is present (Cerner request)</annotation> </assign> </true> </if> <assign value='$ZSTRIP(source.{FT1grp(1).FT1:PerformedByCode(1).IDnumberST},"<>W")' property='context.perfLabId' action='set' /> <assign value='' property='target.{FT1grp(1).FT1:ProcedureCode}' action='remove' /> <assign value='$ZSTRIP(source.{PV1:AssignedPatientLocation.building},"<>W")' property='context.facIdfromPV1' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).ID}' property='context.savePatId' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAccountNumber}' property='context.savePatientAccountNumber' action='set' /> </transform>
